---
title: "phpolars"
subtitle: "Polars data frames for PHP"
---

Query and transform data with [Polars](https://pola.rs) from PHP. Use eager data frames, or build lazy queries with expressions.

The Composer package is `phpstats/phpolars`. PIE installs it as the `php_polars` extension, which is the name that `extension=` and `phpversion()` use. Polars runs inside the PHP process: expressions such as `col('body_mass_g')->truediv(1000)` run on Polars' own threads, and PHP values are created only when code asks for them, for example with `toDicts()`.

The API follows py-polars, Polars' Python package, with camelCase method names and snake_case functions. [Compatibility and limitations](compatibility.qmd) covers the differences and how agreement with py-polars is tested.

{{< include examples/_quickstart.md >}}

The example reads `penguins.csv`, body measurements of 344 penguins from the R `palmerpenguins` package ([penguins](https://github.com/phpstats/datasets#penguins)). [Getting started](getting-started.qmd#a-starter-script) has a complete script and the command that downloads the data.

## Features {#what-it-includes}

- `DataFrame` and `LazyFrame` with py-polars' methods: `select`, `withColumns`, `filter`, `sort`, `groupBy`/`agg`, `join`, `unique`, `pivot`, `unpivot`, `explode`, `describe`, and more.
- Expressions with arithmetic, three-valued logic, aggregations, window functions (`over`), `when`/`then`/`otherwise`, and the `str`, `dt`, `list`, `struct`, and `name` namespaces.
- `Series`, with the same expression methods.
- CSV, Parquet, JSON, NDJSON, and Arrow IPC reading and writing, with lazy scans and streaming sinks, and reading and writing through PDO.
- SQL queries over data frames.
- A thread-pool cap for PHP-FPM (`php_polars.max_threads`).

[Functions and methods](reference/index.qmd) lists every function, selector, and class, with links to the signatures.

## API choice {#the-phpolars-api-or-phibble-and-phplyr}

- The phpolars API (`Phpolars\DataFrame`, `LazyFrame`, `Series`, and expressions) follows Polars' semantics. A missing value is `null`, and aggregates skip it.
- [phibble](https://phibble.phpstats.org)'s `Phibble\Polars\PolarsTable` runs phibble tables and [phplyr](https://phplyr.phpstats.org) pipelines in Polars with dplyr's semantics, in which `null` is R's `NA`. The adapter belongs to phibble and runs on this extension.

[phibble and phplyr](phibble.qmd) covers the choice and the differences in semantics.
